purpose: Canonical file map and workflow for local AI agents (Continue/Ollama/qwen) to reduce hallucinations on JVDesignStudio static site

directories.pages: pages/*.html -> sitemap/search source, uses style-*.css + BUILD:nav-content/footer
directories.tools: tools/*.html -> product-tracker public via tools/project-tracker.html + make-public.js
directories.games: games/*.html -> arcade entries, each needs registry entries
directories.private: F:/Website/studio-workspace/tasks.json, board/index.html (never commit to public repo)

addGame: 2. games-registry.js -> window.JVDS_GAMES[] {id, cat, file, title, tag, bg, kids}
3. content/games.json -> duplicate entry for site generator (id, title, category, url)
5. og image in /og or root (e.g., GardenDefenseCover.webp)
6. games.html grid auto-discovers via JVDS_GAMES; verify via validate:links
addTool: tools/project-tracker.html is source for quest-board.html -> run node make-public.js && node make-app-bundle.js
After editing partials/* run node build.js
addPage: pages/*.html is sitemap/search source -> after adding run npm run build:sitemap (node scripts/build/index.js --only=sitemap)

boardWorkflow: 3. code + npm run validate:links && node board-keeper.cjs --check
4. update tasks.json evidence (must name file + test output e.g. 'tools/pixel-studio.html test:mobile PASS')
gotchas: Never hand-edit tasks.json status to human_review/done; use --request-review/--approve
Never copy studio-workspace/ into quest-board-deploy/ or public repo
Never hand-edit tools/quest-board.html; edit tools/project-tracker.html then make-public.js
Public site must pass validate:public (no private paths like studio-workspace)
Em dashes (-) flagged by check-dashes.cjs as advisory; avoid in public files
WIP limit 3 in_progress but --force allowed; use --sync to resolve drift
All 32 registry games need canonical HTML per A132; wrapper vs raw dual files cause mobile contract drift
Board data: board-data.json regenerated via build:sitemap; don’t hand-edit
Node 24 required; npm.cmd spawnSync on win32 needs shell:true (see bot-verify fix 2026-09-16)
Evidence must include file path + test output + tag-proof keyword (site needs pages/|link|valid|sitemap|contrast)
